youtube.title: Morning Prayer for Today | 2 Corinthians 5:17 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Yesterday is behind you. Hear this.

"Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new." 2 Corinthians 5:17 (KJV)

Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature:

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.
